title: processed_events item (ProcessedEvent)
description: Deduplication of consumed events by eventId (ProcessedEventStore, DISENO S3 (g); RF-080, INV-07).
$comment: Table processed_events (per cell). Partition key only: PK = EVT#<eventId> (no sort key in DISENO). AP-I8: PutItem with attribute_not_exists(PK). TTL attribute ttl = TTL_dedupe.

ttl.description: DynamoDB TTL attribute, epoch seconds. Duration = named parameter TTL_dedupe (no value fixed in the docs).

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency attribute (CLAUDE.md DynamoDB rules; RF-067): every write is conditional on the previous value and increments it.

createdBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id that created the item; system writers use the service-principal uuid configured per service.

updatedBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id of the last write; changes on every write.

updatedAt.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): instant of the last write; changes on every write.

state.description: Constant PROCESSED (the item exists = processed; expires with TTL_dedupe). Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).
